title: Explicit Trajectory Diversity for RL-Based Post-Training of LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.38805v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents often admit multiple high-quality solutions to the same task, differing in reasoning structure, tool-use pattern, or interaction trajectory. Yet existing notions of diversity in LLM post-training are mostly implicit, arising from general stochasticity and regularization mechanisms rather than explicitly targeting task-relevant behavioral variation. While such implicit diversity can be useful, it does not directly specify which forms of behavioral variation should be encouraged for a given task. In this work, we study explicit trajectory diversity in RL-based post-training for LLMs. Our key idea is to define diversity through user-specified, task-specific trajectory descriptors, which map each sampled trajectory to an interpretable behavioral representation, and then measure diversity as a set-level functional over the resulting descriptor matrix. Building on this formulation, we introduce Trajectory-guided Joint Policy Optim

translated_title: 面向大语言模型智能体强化学习后训练的显式轨迹多样性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体在完成同一任务时往往存在多种高质量解决方案，它们在推理结构、工具使用模式或交互轨迹上各不相同。然而，现有的大语言模型后训练中的多样性概念大多是隐式的，源于一般的随机性和正则化机制，而非明确针对与任务相关的行为变化。尽管这种隐式多样性可能有用，但它并不能直接指明对于特定任务应当鼓励哪些形式的行为变化。在本工作中，我们研究基于强化学习的大语言模型后训练中的显式轨迹多样性。我们的核心思想是通过用户指定的、任务特定的轨迹描述子来定义多样性，这些描述子将每条采样轨迹映射为可解释的行为表示，然后将多样性度量定义为在所得描述子矩阵上的集合级泛函。基于这一框架，我们提出了轨迹引导联合策略优化方法……
tldr: 本文提出通过用户指定的任务特定轨迹描述子来显式定义并度量轨迹多样性，并将其融入基于强化学习的大语言模型后训练中，从而明确鼓励与任务相关的行为多样性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces explicit trajectory diversity for RL-based post-training of LLM agents, defined via user-specified task-specific trajectory descriptors and measured as a set-level functional, enabling explicit encouragement of task-relevant behavioral variation.
